name: Corduente (Spain)
description: A red hoist stripe bearing a white pomegranate, the fly of five horizontal stripes of green, white, blue, white and green in the proportions 4:1:4:1:4.
history: Corduente adopted its arms and flag officially in 2005, published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 10 June 2005; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3 composed of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 4-1-4-1-4, green, white, blue, white and green, with a red stripe at the hoist bearing a pomegranate.

features.role: five horizontal stripes at the fly
